title: AccommodationsAvailabilityInput
description: AccommodationsAvailabilityInput schema from Booking.com Demand API

accommodation.description: A signed integer number that uniquely identifies an accommodation property. The full list can be obtained by calling [accommodations/details](/demand/docs/open-api/demand-api/accommodations/accommodations/details).

country.description: The booker country for showing the best price for that user and obeying laws regarding the display of taxes and fees.

platform.description: The booker platform for showing the platform based deals and prices.

state.description: The booker state for showing the best price for that user and obeying laws regarding the display of taxes and fees. Currently applicable only for country US.

travel_purpose.description: The travel purpose of the booker.

user_groups.description: The user groups that the booker is a member of.

checkin.description: The checkin date. Must be within 500 days in the future and in the format yyyy-mm-dd.

checkout.description: The checkout date. Must be later than {checkin}. Must be between 1 and 90 days after {checkin}. Must be within 500 days in the future and in the format yyyy-mm-dd.

currency.description: A three-letter code that uniquely identifies a monetary currency as defined by the ISO 4217 standard. The full list can be obtained by calling common/payments/currencies.

extras.description: Input parameter to request for additional information about this product.include_bundle_variants must be passed in order to retrieve all value added products.

guests.description: The guest details for the request.

allocation.description: The exact allocation of guests to rooms.

children.description: The children ages for this room.

number_of_adults.description: The number of adults for this room.
The number of adults for the search.

payment.description: Payment input information to filter results.

timing.description: This parameter specifies that the results should only return accommodation and blocks that contain the specified payment timings.
